description: Returns statutory EU compliance dates (CBAM, EUDR and other laws) with the Official Journal source, quote and SHA-256 for each. Use it to browse or filter deadlines and to find ids; use compliance_get_deadline for one known id, tenders_list_deadline_changes for tender submission deadlines and funding_list_changes for grant call deadlines. Inputs (all optional, they narrow together): law (name from the returned laws list, case-insensitive, e.g. CBAM), status (upcoming or applies), from and to (YYYY-MM-DD). With no filters it returns every date, ordered by date then id, without paging. Output: as_of, verified, count, laws[] and deadlines[] with id, law, obligation, date, days_until, status, source URL, quote, SHA-256 and history. Data is bundled from the acts and reviewed as of verified; days_until is computed today. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

law.description: Known law name (case-insensitive), e.g. CBAM or EUDR; only laws in the returned laws list are accepted; omit for all laws

status.description: upcoming or applies Allowed: upcoming, applies; e.g. upcoming.

to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. 2027-12-31. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: compliance_list_deadlines
title: List EU compliance deadlines
